title: Agent Effectiveness
description: Per-agent effectiveness metrics. Used by Self-Improvement Agent for monthly analysis. See Part V of cursor-kit-v2-FINAL.md.

sessions_tracked.description: Number of sessions this agent has participated in.

gate_failure_rate.description: Fraction of gate checks that failed. Threshold: > 0.20 over last 10 sessions triggers Self-Improvement investigation.

rework_cycle_rate.description: Fraction of dispatched tasks requiring rework. Threshold: > 0.30 triggers investigation.

escalation_rate.description: Fraction of dispatched tasks escalated to human. Threshold: > 0.15 triggers investigation.

avg_token_burn_l1.description: Average token consumption for L1 tasks. Threshold: > 2x median triggers cost investigation.

avg_token_burn_l2.description: Average token consumption for L2+ tasks.
